description: Cagey: gives the opponent nothing, and would rather carry deadwood than feed a meld.

opponent_is_close.instructions: From `opponent.discarded` (oldest first), `opponent.took_from_discard` and `stock.drawn_so_far`, how close is the opponent to being able to knock?
criteria: Showing me nothing yet - early, scattered discards.
Starting to keep what fits together; still loose.
Collecting with intent: I should stop feeding them.
Ready to end this hand as soon as they draw what they need.
One card from gin - anything I throw could finish them.

opponent_wants.instructions: Which slot of `candidates` is the opponent hunting, judged from what they have taken in `opponent.took_from_discard` and thrown away in `opponent.discarded`? Answer with the slot number.

move.instructions: It is my turn. Which move gives the opponent least, given what `read` says they are collecting? Carrying deadwood is an acceptable price for not feeding them.

criteria.take_upcard: Take `upcard`: only when it melds, since taking tells them what I am building.
criteria.draw_stock: Draw from `stock`: says nothing about my hand, which is usually worth more than `upcard`.
criteria.discard: Throw this card - safe to give away, whatever `candidates` says it costs me.
criteria.knock: End the hand now, before they can - worth it when `read.opponent_is_close` says they are nearly there.
criteria.gin: Go gin: every card melded, nothing left over.
